name: Dragon Emperor Monarch

passive.name: Monarch of Destruction
passive.desc: Antares' dragon fear. Every enemy card starts with 6.4% less damage. Every hit sets the whole enemy deck on fire for 2 turns. Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20%. Instantly kills enemies under 5% HP (not bosses).

tierNote: Top ATK and HP, plus burn and a 20% bench hit on every attack. Only a 1-on-1 loss to Moon Eye Ghost keeps it at S.
bestTraitNote: Prodigy lifts its sim matchup 55 → 71, the best pick. More ATK also means a bigger bench hit. Rare pick: Iron Body.
strengths: Highest ATK and HP of the current cards
Every hit burns the whole enemy deck and hits the whole bench for 20%
Every enemy card deals 6.4% less damage from the start
weaknesses: No defense of its own: no damage reduction, block or revive
Loses 1-on-1 to Moon Eye Ghost: 3 blocks and a revive outlast it
notes: Best opener: every hit burns and splashes the whole enemy bench, so the rest of the team fights cards that are already hurt.

name: Moon Eye Ghost

passive.name: Infinite Tsukuyomi
passive.desc: Madara: Every enemy card starts with 5.5% less damage. Every 2nd attack also hits the card behind for 35%. Blocks the first 3 hits completely. Comes back once with 14% HP.

tierNote: Wins every 1-on-1 thanks to 3 full blocks and a revive, but mid stats and a small team effect hold it at A.
bestTraitNote: Prodigy lifts its sim matchup 54 → 69. ×1.25 HP also makes its 14% revive bigger. Rare pick: Bloodlust.
strengths: Wins every 1-on-1 against the current cards
Every enemy card deals 5.5% less damage; every 2nd attack also hits the next card for 35%
weaknesses: Atomic Shadow Lord ignores its blocks
Strong burn can flip its close fight with Dragon Emperor Monarch
Hits only one bench card, and only every 2nd attack
notes: Its blocks soak the first hits of every attacker. Stack its -5.5% with Dragon Emperor Monarch's -6.4%: enemies deal about 88% damage.

name: Atomic Shadow Lord

passive.name: I AM ATOMIC
passive.desc: Cid Kagenou, the Eminence in Shadow. Its first hit on each new enemy does 2.3x damage. Its first attack also hits the whole enemy bench for 26%. Ignores shields, dodges and barriers. 20% chance to dodge each hit. Shadow Garden cards in your deck get +16% damage and HP.

tierNote: A 2.3x opener on every new enemy and a bench hit, but below-average stats and no 1-on-1 wins drag it to C.
bestTraitNote: Prodigy lifts its sim matchup 42 → 63. The +30% first hit stacks on its 2.3x opener. Rare pick: Bloodlust.
strengths: First hit on every new enemy does 2.3x
First attack also hits the whole enemy bench for 26%
weaknesses: Loses every 1-on-1 among the current cards
Below-average HP: falls fast in long fights
Shadow Garden +16% does nothing yet (no other Shadow Garden cards)
notes: Cleaner: after the openers its 2.3x first hit lands on every new, already-burned enemy. Rank goes up if Shadow Garden cards are added.

name: Beast Emperor

passive.name: Strongest Creature
passive.desc: Kaido can't die. Survives its first killing blow with 1 HP. Takes 30% less damage. Can't be stunned, frozen or paralyzed. Every 3rd attack does 2.5x damage.

tierNote: Takes 30% less damage and survives a killing blow, but the lowest ATK and HP now lose to Monarch and Ghost.
bestTraitNote: Prodigy lifts its sim matchup 50 → 66, more than Undying (59): lowest stats gain most from ×1.25. Rare: Bloodlust.
strengths: Takes 30% less damage (the only damage reduction in the library)
Survives the first killing blow at 1 HP
Cannot be stunned, frozen or paralyzed
weaknesses: Lowest ATK and HP of the current cards
No team effect: only helps itself
No AoE: fights one enemy at a time
notes: Anchor at the back: damage reduction and the 1 HP save make it the last card to fall. Dropped from S after the update: no more +6% per hit.
